_comment: Acknowledgement of support. Sponsor NAMES always show and need nobody's permission. To add a logo: download the official file (see assets/sponsors/README.md for the source and the permission position for each), save it in assets/sponsors/ under exactly the filename in `file`, and it appears automatically — no code change. Until the file exists the entry shows the name alone. Set "hidden": true to keep an entry on file without displaying it.
